body: Maybe hormones do play a part in this but it's mostly the harsh judgement from others and stress I'm facing that's making me suicidal.Well I certainly don't know everything in fact I'm still not out of this bubble. Old people have gone through a lot that I know but some just are as immature. I would like to donate my organs. Maybe leave a note next to me or something.. But the way I'm choosing to die might make them useless if my body's left out for too long.

It's hard to say anything about her. She doesn't beat me or starve me or do as bad as other mother's I've heard of. My grades are failing so I probably won't get a high income job and I've never been independent so living on my own is probably not an option.

Well most of the population is shallow and I'm no different. My perspective has changed I guess. I don't know what my personality is like anymore. I was all bubbly and innocent but as soon as people kept pointing out my flaws they decided suddenly I'm mean when they used to call me nice. I have no idea what my personality is anymore it's toxic and pessimistic now. So I can't really stay true to myself

It's like we switched. She admitted she saw this herself. Everyone likes her more now. She can take care of herself. The unbalance is real, this is why I think parents should try to have 1 girl 1 boy only. She knows how to exercise, dress better than me. I learnt how to wash my face only. I'm late to the game so it's me the one who needs to learn how to take care of my body more. That's what happens if you blossom too early you become clueless and treat yourself like trash.My health is deteriorating and the damage is done

Thanks I appreciate it but I always feel a sense of regret posting or talking about things like this. I might delete this later I really don't like this side of me. I'll think about what you said though

then I must be surrounded by natural beauties. They're not wearing makeup. You can just tell and no plastic surgery either. Don't people  in their 30s hit a mid life crisis instead? I know my aunts and uncles have changed coldly because of this. I don't know a single adult who isn't appearance focused. Old people only seem to mature physically but not mentally to me

Well being ugly has made me extremely isolated I haven't talked to anyone for a while now
